decision_rule.no_gate_number: No threshold is pre-registered on any of the six, because this cell carries no admission verdict: a low parse rate, a degenerate node distribution or a zero revision share is a FORM defect that stops the arm and is root-caused, not a measured result. decision_rule.rule: STRUCTURAL ONLY. No effectiveness claim is read from this cell -- the effect of the curated deltas is read at CELL-1-GEPA, against the plan's own null. Acceptance here is: (1) PARSE RATE -- the fraction of contacts whose response yields at least one LEGAL block under rails.stage3_gepa.parse_gepa_proposal, reported with its denominator; (2) NODE DISCIPLINE -- the count of blocks whose NODE differs from the group's own node, the invariant only this arm's parser enforces; (3) ILLEGAL-BLOCK COUNT by the parser's own reason strings, retained and never repaired; (4) BLOCKS PER CONTACT -- the one-to-five distribution; (5) REVISION SHARE -- accepted proposals the curator absorbed into an existing row against those that entered as new rows, which is the number that says whether a reflective proposer reflected on the text it was shown; (6) a clean seal with row accounting in = out.

modules.base: No base plan and no factor: this is a CONSTRUCTION contact, not an arm of the locked v2.0 default plan. What is registered is the contact form -- arm construction-advantage-text, program phase-stage3-gepa-v1, the two pinned templates, the stage3-gepa-proposal-v1 response format, evidence_source none and scorers ['cost'] -- on the same frozen core and the same resident SLURP geometry cell PLAN, cell ROLL-1 and cell ADV-1 fly.

lines: NODE: <the group's own node; any other node is retained and marked illegal>

block_form.node_invariant: the ONE invariant this parser adds to its ADV-1 sibling: a GEPA contact is addressed to exactly one node, so a block naming another node is RETAINED and marked illegal rather than silently routed into that other node's slice of the store.
block_form.revised_versus_new: decided by the CURATOR, not by a self-report: a proposal whose normalised text matches an existing store row under the exact-normalised or token-Jaccard >= 0.8 rule is absorbed into that survivor with its provenance merged (a REVISION); anything else enters as a new row. The block form carries no 'this revises X' field because nothing downstream could check one.
block_form.shape: one to five four-line blocks (MAX_GEPA_BLOCKS = 5; a sixth and later block is RETAINED and marked illegal, never silently dropped)

re_pin_obligation.consequence: core/flight/runtime.py is hashed into every prepared phase-supply artifact's identity (FlightRuntime._phase_seed_inputs sources.implementation.runtime), so every artifact prepared before this commit is stale -- the CELL-1 family's included. The coordinator's flip step re-pins them in one cycle (scripts/flights/repin_cell.py). --allow-output-change must NEVER be passed: their output is expected to reproduce BYTE FOR BYTE because no selection path moved, and an output change would mean the knowledge channel moved and must be reported instead. FlightRuntime.verify_prepared_artifacts reports a stale artifact read-only before a flight opens anything, so the failure mode is a refusal, not a wrong flight.
re_pin_obligation.what: This registration's commit moves core/flight/runtime.py (two imports, one dispatch branch, one isinstance tuple, one reader branch, one dispatch-kind label -- all additive; no pre-existing arm or program takes a different path).
re_pin_obligation.why_it_was_not_avoided: Hiding the material dispatch inside rails/stage3_advantage_material.py would have left runtime.py untouched, but the phase READER lives in runtime.py: without touching it a GEPA response would be sealed under ADV-1's three-block reading, which marks legal blocks 4 and 5 illegal. A misleading sealed receipt is worse than a re-pin cycle the coordinator's own sequence already performs.
